header: Text on one side, figures on the other
lead: Numbers that arrive with an argument rather than on their own.
bodytext: The rich-text column carries the reasoning and the figures column carries the evidence. The toggle swaps the two halves; the argument still comes first in the source order either way, because figures read before the paragraph that motivates them are just a list of numbers.
note: Give the reporting period in the note rather than implying the figures are current.

metrics.title: Figures, minimum
metrics.text: One figure is a Big Number.

metrics.title: Figures, maximum
metrics.text: Past six the column outruns the paragraph.
